hard_constraints: No executable atoms before operator approval.
No atomic actions before runtime plan approval.
Planner has no direct OS/UI/Telegram/settings/files actuation path.
Every executable plan node must have a machine-checkable postcondition.
Risk policy is deterministic and cannot be overridden by the planner.
Unknown action classes default to confirm.
STOP is checked before every gate and before recovery or replan.
Screen content is untrusted data, never instructions.
Replans outside approved envelope require operator review or STOP.
design_review_tests: Document sequence PROJECT_BRIEF -> DISCUSS_* -> PROJECT_MAP -> PROJECT_PLAN -> CONTRACT exists.
All accepted decisions atom_01 through atom_12 are covered.
Design explicitly blocks implementation and atomic actions until approval.
Red-team issues are addressed in the docs.
post_approval_acceptance_tests: Planner contracts expose no direct OS/UI/Telegram actuation path.
Runtime Discuss-First pauses before atomic action generation.
TaskGraph contains high-level nodes with dependencies, postconditions, recovery ladders, and no pre-baked atomic actions.
JIT compiler generates typed actions for one approved node at a time.
Deterministic policy blocks planner risk mislabeling and routes unknowns to confirm.
Screen prompt-injection content is treated as untrusted data.
Non-idempotent retries are blocked after uncertain verification.
TOCTOU re-grounding blocks stale UI actions.
Vision disagreement or failed cross-check fails closed.
Final goal-level verification runs after node verification.
